observations.evidence: Hips swung out on 4 of 11 moves
observations.drill: Practice flagging on steep terrain to keep hips square to the wall.
Favor open-hand/half-crimp grip on small edges to reduce pulley strain.

positives.evidence: Clean heel-hook on the top-out move

coaching_text: Solid climb overall — your footwork is a strength. Watch the hip position on steep moves; letting your hips drift from the wall costs reach and loads your arms more than it needs to. On crimps, easing off full-crimp in favor of open-hand will protect your fingers long-term without costing much grip strength at this angle.
